messages.sourceEnglish: Compare a fixed US station’s weather observations with clear dates and missing readings.
messages.text: Vhambedzani thaluso dza mutsho dza tshititshi tshi sa shandukiho tsha US dzi re na madatumu o khwathaho na zwivhalo zwi siho.

messages.sourceEnglish: Review a public US weather station
messages.text: Tsedzulusani tshititshi tsha mutsho tsha tshitshavha tsha US

messages.sourceEnglish: Choose United States, then load the fixed public station example. Observation and retrieval times stay separate; this does not supply farm weather or planting advice.
messages.text: Nangani United States, nahone ni layishe tsumbo ya tshititshi tsha tshitshavha tshi sa shandukiho. Zwifhinga zwa u vhona na zwa u dzhia zwi dzula zwo fhambana; hezwi a zwi nei mutsho wa bulasi kana nyeletshedzo ya u zwala.
